own.title: Phone notification deep link
own.summary: Opens the chat of a tapped notification after the phone app was closed.
own.check: Kill the app from Recents, tap a T3 notice: the app opens the chat of the notice, not the last chat. Steps: own-patches/1407-notice-link/report.md of Shell issue 1411.
own.dropWhen: The upstream MainActivity of the tag already calls setIntent(intent) in onNewIntent.

own.title: Phone dictation server settings
own.summary: Uses server dictionary words and cleanup for phone dictation and keeps recording through usage refreshes.
own.check: With a Project dictionary alias and a cleanup model on the server, phone dictation inserts the dictionary term and cleaned text. A recording keeps going through the usage refresh of the server (Shell issue 1453). Steps: own-patches/1409-server-voice-settings/report.md of Shell issue 1411.
own.dropWhen: Upstream phone voice input sends speechProjectCustomWords and calls postProcess for an environment destination.

own.title: Question form mic button
own.summary: Shows the mic button and recording bar inside free-text question form boxes on mobile.
own.check: A T3 question form with a free-text answer shows the composer mic button inside the answer box, and the recording bar takes its place inside the box during dictation. A dictated answer lands in the field with the dictionary word and cleanup of the composer. The one feature in this list: Morgan allowed it on 2026-11-16 in Shell issue 1448.
own.dropWhen: The upstream QuestionAttachments of the tag already calls useVoiceInputController for the free-text answer.

own.title: Child end notice hold
own.summary: Groups delegated child end notices for an idle parent up to 120 seconds.
own.check: Start two delegated children, then let the parent finish its turn. End one child, then end the other 30 seconds later. The parent gets one notice with both task IDs. With only one child, its notice arrives at once. With another child still running, the first notice arrives after 120 seconds. Restart the server during the hold: it still delivers the notice by the original deadline, or at startup if that deadline passed. With A from parent run R1 and B and C from R2, end A, then end B 30 seconds later while C still runs. A and B notices arrive together at B's end, with no later deadline notice.
own.dropWhen: Upstream groups child end notices for idle parents with a hold of at most 120 seconds and restores held notices after a server restart without a database migration.

own.title: Question form draft save
own.summary: Saves unsent question form answers on mobile so they survive an app restart.
own.check: Unsent answers of a T3 question form survive an app restart: choose an option and type text without sending, switch apps, force-close the app, open it again, and the form shows the same option and text. The answers are saved in user-input-drafts/drafts.json in the app documents folder. Builds on 1448-form-free-text-mic, which also changes QuestionAttachments.
own.dropWhen: Upstream apps/mobile saves question form answers to disk, so userInputDraftsByRequestKeyAtom (or what replaced it) is loaded from a file at app start.

own.title: Voice cleanup Codex credits
own.summary: Keeps Codex Terra for voice cleanup while Codex credits remain.
own.check: With the Codex week window at 100 % and has_credits true, a voice cleanup on the server runs on the Codex cleanup model (Terra), not on the Claude fallback, and the Settings usage bar still shows 100 %. With no credits, T3 falls back as before. From Shell issue 1210.
own.dropWhen: The upstream exhaustedUsageWindow of the tag lets Codex credits (hasCredits or unlimited) keep a full Codex plan window from blocking.

own.title: Shared server cleanup prompt
own.summary: Uses voice-cleanup-prompt.txt on the server for Built-in voice cleanup.
own.check: Put a prompt in voice-cleanup-prompt.txt in the server userdata folder. A phone dictation and a desktop dictation with Instructions on Built-in get the same cleanup from that prompt. With the file empty or gone, both use the built-in prompt. A desktop Custom prompt still wins. From Shell issue 1210.
own.dropWhen: Upstream lets the server replace the built-in voice cleanup prompt for every client, or the phone sends the desktop custom prompt.

own.title: Voice cleanup fallback model
own.summary: Adds a Fallback cleanup model row under Settings, Voice, Cleanup.
own.check: Settings > Voice > Cleanup shows a Fallback cleanup model row under Cleanup model, and it saves the model. When the cleanup model is out of usage (for Codex: also no credits) or cannot run, cleanup runs on the fallback model when it can run, else on T3's own fallback. Morgan's feature exception of 2026-11-17 in Shell issue 1210. Builds on 1472-codex-credits.
own.dropWhen: Upstream server settings have a fallback model for voice transcript cleanup.

own.title: PR watch short poll
own.summary: Sweeps watched pull requests every 30 seconds while a check runs, and every 2 minutes otherwise.
own.check: Watch a PR while its CI runs. The wake comes at most about 30 seconds after GitHub shows the green status, plus the read time. With no check running, the sweeps stay 2 minutes apart. Measure the median green-to-wake time over 10 PRs with watch-delay/measure.py of Shell issue 1652.
own.dropWhen: Upstream PullRequestWatchReactor sweeps more often than every 2 minutes while a watched pull request has a running check, or wakes on GitHub commit status events.

own.title: Keep failed phone voice recordings
own.summary: Keeps a failed or backgrounded remote voice recording on mobile and adds Send again and Discard in the draft and form card.
own.check: On the preview app with Transcribe on set to a laptop environment: cut the laptop server during upload, then tap Send again after reconnect and confirm the text enters the draft one time with no new recording; also switch apps during a recording, come back, and confirm Recording saved with Send again and Discard; confirm Discard, draft reset, and changing destination delete the file. Tracked in t3code-patches issue 34.
own.dropWhen: Upstream mobile VoiceInputProvider enables retryFailedRecording, separates remote preflight from live transcription, keeps partial batch recordings on background, and shows Send again and Discard in the composer and question form.

own.title: Preserve pending forms on reboot
own.summary: Orders agent scopes before the T3 boot service and drops late shutdown exit cancellations so pending forms survive reboot.
own.check: Run vp test run apps/server/src/process/agentScope.test.ts apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProviderSessionManager.test.ts: agent scopes include --property=Before=t3code.service when T3_BOOT_SERVICE_UNIT is set, shutdown drops late exit cancellations so user_input stays pending, and unexpected non-shutdown exits still report error. Tracked in t3code-patches issue 44 and Shell issue 1716.
own.dropWhen: Upstream agentScope orders transient agent scopes before T3_BOOT_SERVICE_UNIT on reboot and ProviderSessionManager drops late exit cancellations during programmatic server shutdown.

own.title: Cache Muse usage limits across restarts
own.summary: Persists the latest verified Muse subscription usage limits to an atomic JSON file so Limits shows bars right after a reboot.
own.check: Run vp test run packages/provider-muse/src/server/usageCache.test.ts packages/provider-muse/src/server/usageProbe.test.ts: verified email logins restore unexpired limits with original checkedAt after restart, account switch or logout or label-only login never restores stale limits, expired or corrupt entries are dropped, and newer live reads win. Morgan's feature exception of 2026-11-26 in Shell issue 1716 and t3code-patches issue 44.
own.dropWhen: Upstream provider-muse persists verified subscription usage limits across server restarts without a database migration.

own.title: Antigravity usage limits
own.summary: Restores local Antigravity usage bars and limits from Google's quota endpoints.
own.check: With a fresh antigravity-oauth-token on disk (renewed by running an Antigravity turn) and the patched T3 server running after update, Usage -> Limits and model-pick --usage show Antigravity Gemini and 3p quota windows. Tracked in t3code-patches issue 45.
own.dropWhen: Upstream Antigravity reports usage limits over official ACP or stops writing antigravity-oauth-token.
